text:
sara: Heads up — staging is seeing a small but steady uptick in 503s on /embed (around 5%). Root cause looks like a KV eviction race. Need an expedited hotfix to staging and a fast promotion if green. tagging @max @doris for ops approval.

deploy-bot: Deploy request created: hotfix/kv-evict-fix@2026-03-21 -> staging. CI: 1/4 checks passed, 3 pending. To approve reply 'approve' or run `/deploy approve --fast-pass`.

max: approve. :thumbsup:

doris: Quick Q — rollback criteria? if errors >=2% for 5m do immediate rollback, or stricter? need exact metric to automate alerting.

eng-lead: +1 on having clear rollback thresholds. Also please paste a tiny release note here for auditing. If criteria are reasonable I'm OK with fast-pass to staging.

sara: Proposed plan: staging with fast-pass (skip canary), 10m active monitor; rollback if p95 latency increases >30ms OR 5xx rate >=1% sustained for 5m. If green at 10m, promote to prod using staged traffic (10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m pauses). Release note below.

sara: ```
Release: hotfix/kv-evict-fix
Why: edge KV eviction races causing transient 503s on embeddings
Change: add eviction guard + extra metrics hook
Rollback: revert commit 4f2c9b7
Deploy plan: staging fast-pass, 10m monitor; prod staged promotion if green
Owner: sara (release-ops)
```

max: ack, i'll own the monitor window.

deploy-bot: CI checks now 4/4 green. Ready to deploy. Trigger with: `/deploy hotfix/kv-evict-fix --env=staging --fast-pass`

sara: executing now.

deploy-bot: Starting rollout to staging (fast-pass). Stage: deploy to 3 nodes -> 1/3 applied.

doris: watching logs — initial warmup only, no spike in 5xx yet.

sara: paste logs: ```[deploy][staging] node-2: apply patch ok
[metrics] 5xx: 0.2% -> 0.1%```

deploy-bot: Monitor timer: 10m window started. Will report summary after window.

[10m later]
deploy-bot: Monitor summary (10m): 5xx rate 0.12% (down), p95 latency +8ms. No automated thresholds breached.

eng-lead: :rocket: looks good to me for promotion.

max: promote.

sara: Promoting to prod with staged rollout: `/deploy promote hotfix/kv-evict-fix --env=prod --strategy=staged --steps=10,50,100 --pause=10m`

deploy-bot: Promotion started: shifting traffic 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Pauses 10m between steps and runs health checks.

doris: 10% step looks fine from logs and traces. No error spike.

sara: Thanks team. I'll file a short post-release note and monitor for 24h. Closing thread when stable. :white_check_mark:
